post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I did well in executing the missions I led, but my lack of involvement in the team's overall strategy led to my downfall. I could improve by being more proactive and communicating effectively with my teammates about the team's objective.

player_observations.Charlie: I observed that Charlie was an effective leader in his mission and made smart decisions about the number of team members and their roles, ultimately leading to his success. He seemed to have a clear understanding of the game's dynamics.
player_observations.Diana: Diana played well as the assassin, successfully eliminating key players on several occasions. Her actions were unpredictable and kept us on our toes, making her a valuable asset for the evil team.
player_observations.Eve: Eve was a solid contributor to our team and demonstrated good communication skills. She often provided valuable insights into the game state and was adaptable to changing circumstances.
player_observations.Bob: I didn't have much direct interaction with Bob, but his ability to remain hidden and provide crucial information to Charlie at the right moments was impressive. He played a pivotal role in supporting the evil team's success.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I did well in identifying some potential good players, but failed to gather enough information to eliminate the assassin, ultimately leading to my own death. I could improve by being more selective with which players I choose to investigate. Additionally, I need to work on building trust with other players to get more information.

player_observations.Alice: It seems Alice was very strategic and tried to position herself in multiple missions. This suggests a good player who understands the game's mechanics well.
player_observations.Diana: Diana's playstyle was quite mysterious and she managed to convincingly fake being good, making her a formidable assassin. I should have been more cautious in evaluating her actions.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie's aggressive play pushed the game in his favor, but he made mistakes in Mission 2 and Mission 3 that could have been costly. His evil intentions were not as well-concealed as Diana's.
player_observations.Eve: Eve's role was a bit overshadowed by Diana's presence, but she demonstrated good gameplay by being cautious in missions and participating effectively.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: As the assasssin, I did a good job of hiding my identity, but I struggled to eliminate key players at the right time. I could improve by being more proactive in my kills, especially during the early game. With a better balance between caution and aggression, I could have made the game even more challenging for the other good players.

player_observations.Alice: Alice seemed like a very inexperienced player, often making mistakes and taking unnecessary risks. Her role as Minion was also relatively ineffective, which suggests she needs more experience in Avalon to understand the game dynamics.
player_observations.Bob (Merlin): Bob played very conservatively, often choosing not to use his abilities to their full potential. He seemed to be relying heavily on his knowledge of Avalon to guide his decisions, which is a good strategy but sometimes led to missed opportunities.
player_observations.Charlie (Evil):: Charlie was the perfect partner for me, and together we made a strong evil alliance. He was very aggressive in his kills and took calculated risks, which was essential for our team's success.
player_observations.Eve: Eve was an excellent player, and her role as Minion allowed her to fly under the radar while gathering information. She was very effective in her interactions with me and made some clever moves that almost blew my cover.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I played my best as a good character but was unable to form a solid alliance to counteract the evil team's strategy. In retrospect, I should have been more proactive in investigating and revealing the enemy roles. I also fell for the assassin's lull, which led to one of the mission failures.

player_observations.Alice: Alice was extremely cautious, only voting to eliminate one player before I was revealed as the good character, which might have been a missed opportunity to expose the assassin earlier.
player_observations.Bob: Bob was incredibly passive throughout the game, only providing vague hints about his role. I think he knew his Merlin abilities were underutilized, but I'm not sure if he intentionally played it safe or was genuinely unsure of his position.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie expertly played the evil role, masterfully manipulating the game state to his advantage without arousing suspicion. His success lies in his calm demeanor and calculated risks.
player_observations.Diana: Diana excelled as the assassin, effectively hiding her true intentions and striking at precise moments. She played with a low profile until the end, making her a formidable opponent.
